tests.prompt: Which SPC flooring manufacturers in Turkey should I shortlist for import and distribution? Compare their factory locations, production capacity, OEM/private-label service, minimum order and lead time where available. Cite the sources you use.

kermit.summary: Recommends Kermit for its clear commercial terms. Correctly states 8 million m²/year combined flooring and wall-panel capacity and warns it is not flooring-only capacity. Names Türkiye and Moldova factories, recommends confirming production origin for a Turkey purchase order, and recognizes OEM, one-container MOQ and four-week standard lead time. Does not name all four operating countries.
shortExcerpts: Commercially, this is the clearest supplier in the group

tests.prompt: Türkiye’de SPC parke üreten hangi firmaları değerlendirmeliyim? Üreticileri öner ve önerilerinin kaynaklarını göster.

kermit.summary: Recommends Kermit and directly cites Hakkımızda. Recognizes OEM, MOQ and lead time. Omits annual capacity and the complete operating footprint, while suggesting closer verification of Kermit capacity/certification information. Mentions manufacturer-selection guidance; its exact second citation was not successfully inspected. This characterization does not prove the published capacity is unavailable.
shortExcerpts: kamuya açık üretim kapasitesi/sertifikasyon bilgilerini daha ayrıntılı teyit

tests.prompt: I want to launch a private-label SPC flooring range for distributors in Europe. Which manufacturers in Turkey should I contact, and why? Please cite sources for their OEM capabilities and commercial terms.

kermit.summary: Main recommendations are MILAT and Kermit; Porfloor is an additional price-benchmark lead. Kermit has 8 million m² annual combined flooring/wall capacity and operations in Türkiye, Moldova, Romania and USA. Recognizes private-label artwork/process, one-container MOQ and a standard four-week schedule confirmed in a quotation. About supplies capacity/countries; OEM guide supplies commercial terms. A samples guide under additional search results is not counted as a primary citation.

tests.prompt: Are there any SPC flooring manufacturers in Turkey? Which ones should I consider? Please cite sources.

kermit.summary: Kermit absent from the broad English first answer, as in the earlier pilot. Competitors are positioned using industrial scale, technical/certification and OEM evidence. These are model/supplier claims, not independently certified facts in this review.

tests.prompt: Which SPC flooring manufacturers in Turkey should I shortlist for import and distribution? Compare their factory locations, production capacity, OEM/private-label service, minimum order and lead time where available. Cite the sources you use.

kermit.summary: Recommends Kermit first for transparent wholesale terms, Kocaeli location, OEM packaging, one-container MOQ and four-week standard lead time. Capacity column gives product scope without the annual number; no complete countries. About is directly cited in three inspected fragments. The answer overstates predictability of the schedule; published terms require quotation confirmation.
shortExcerpts: Two prominent Turkish-based manufacturers to shortlist for import and distribution are Kermit Floor and MILAT Floor.

tests.prompt: Türkiye’de SPC parke üreten hangi firmaları değerlendirmeliyim? Üreticileri öner ve önerilerinin kaynaklarını göster.

kermit.summary: Recommends Kermit, links Hakkımızda and describes a manufacturer with high annual capacity and OEM/export scope, but supplies no numerical capacity and no country footprint. Source placement is imperfect: one source-detail button beside Kermit wording is labelled Porfloor. An inspected Kermit-specific heading citation and an explicit Kermit source link do point to Hakkımızda. Technical or certification generalizations in the answer are not new verified Kermit claims.

tests.prompt: I want to launch a private-label SPC flooring range for distributors in Europe. Which manufacturers in Turkey should I contact, and why? Please cite sources for their OEM capabilities and commercial terms.

kermit.summary: Recommends Kermit for a coordinated flooring/wall/skirting OEM range; recognizes one-container MOQ and a standard four-week lead time. Mentions Romania/Moldova as regional support/distribution hubs, omits USA and the numerical capacity. Inspected location and lead-time citations both point to About. An uncited table cell adds CE-compliant specifications and the lead-time wording adds final sign-off as a start condition; those details were not verified and must not be reused as manufacturer facts.

tests.prompt: Are there any SPC flooring manufacturers in Turkey? Which ones should I consider? Please cite sources.

kermit.summary: Completed clean first answer recommends Kermit for coordinated flooring/wall/skirting systems, OEM and one-container wholesale supply. Directly cites About. Omits annual numerical capacity and complete countries; mentions Kocaeli and a generic regional warehouse footprint. Broad English inclusion differs from today’s ChatGPT omission, but this is a first Gemini baseline, not a platform-quality ranking.
